title: Pan-Fried Russian Dumplings with Yukon Gold Potatoes
description: A hearty and comforting dish that combines pan-fried Russian dumplings with crispy Yukon gold potatoes.

ingredients.name: Russian dumplings
ingredients.notes: Available in many international grocery stores or online.

ingredients.name: Yukon gold potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose medium-sized potatoes for best results.

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Garnish with fresh parsley for a pop of color.

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and cook the old fashioned snappy bacon until crispy. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and pan-fry the Russian dumplings until golden brown on the bottom (about 2-3 minutes).
Flip the dumplings and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, peel the Yukon gold potatoes and cut them into 1-inch cubes.
Add the potato cubes to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes or until they are tender and golden brown, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pan-fried dumplings with the crispy bacon, pan-fried potatoes, and garnished with chopped fresh parsley (if using).
Enjoy your delicious and comforting meal!
